items.title: Gino's East

notes: This one decides whether the afternoon works

items.title: Chicago Riverwalk
notes: Down the stairs at the north-east corner of the bridge

items.title: Hotel — break
items.place: Holiday Inn Express Chicago Magnificent Mile
items.fixedWhy: Change into smart casual now — LH enforces a dress code
notes: Check in properly, rest
No chance to change later
Bring a jacket — it cools off tonight

items.title: Zanies — Jay Jurden
items.fixedWhy: Doors 6pm, first come — arriving at doors is what gets us a good spot
notes: 21+, photo ID required
Jay Jurden on at 7:00
Two-item minimum per person
Ask for the check at 8:20 — every table settles at once

items.title: Night walk starts — Chicago Theatre sign
items.where: Uber drops us at State & Lake, under the marquee

notes.t: Chicago Theatre — the drop-off. Stand across State to get the whole marquee in frame
Marina City — 5 min north up State. The two corncob towers, right on the river
Wrigley Building — 6 min further east along the north bank. Floodlit white

notes: 11 min of walking in total, the rest is standing and looking
Skip Marina City if we are running late — it saves 5 min

items.title: Night walk ends — Wrigley Building
items.where: 400 N Michigan Ave, on the north bank

notes.t: Marina City — passed on the way here, 5 min back down the river

notes: Floodlit white, and it faces the bridge — best seen from across the river
Uber to LondonHouse from here, or walk it in 3 min over the bridge

items.title: LH Rooftop
items.fixedWhy: Food service stops at 11pm — order early
notes: Only 3 min on foot from the Wrigley Building, straight over the DuSable bridge — walk it if the car is more than a few minutes away
90 minute table limit
Order food as soon as we sit

items.title: 3 Arts Club Café
notes: Inside RH Chicago — the atrium courtyard
Order at 10:00 sharp — the kitchen is the slow part
Out the door at 10:45, the whole day hangs off this

items.title: Art Institute
items.fixedWhy: 11:55 is a hard out — the 12:45 Pokémon entry is timed and will not wait
notes: Tickets on your phone before you arrive — do not queue at the desk
Skip the coat check, it is a 10 minute round trip you do not have
Thorne Miniature Rooms first — lower level, straight down

notes.t: 11:25 — one thing only after Thorne: the Impressionists, up the Grand Staircase

notes: Set an alarm for 11:50

items.title: Field Museum — Pokémon Fossil Museum
items.place: Field Museum of Natural History Chicago
items.fixedWhy: Timed add-on entry at 12:45 — the buffer is the bag check, not the art
notes: General admission AND the Pokémon add-on both need to be in your wallet
Bag check at the door — budget 15 minutes just to get inside
12:35 — be at the exhibition hall, it is a walk from the entrance
2:00 — SUE the T. rex, then Evolving Planet
Soldier Field is an 8 minute walk from here — you are coming back tonight

items.title: Hotel — break
items.place: Holiday Inn Express Chicago Magnificent Mile
items.fixedWhy: Pack the clear bag now — 42 minutes, no bag check at the stadium
notes: Clear bag only: max 12"x6"x12", or a clutch under 4.5"x6.5"
Tickets in your phone wallet — 63,000 phones at the gates
A light layer each
Check which gate your ticket says

items.title: Naia

items.title: YE — Soldier Field
items.fixedWhy: Security line at 6:30 — 63,000 people go through these gates
notes: Through security, then: food → bathroom → seats
Food queues peak at 8:15 when everyone realises he is not on yet
YE on at about 9:00 — 8pm is the ticketed time, he has run an hour late all tour
Show ends about 11:00
